public_threshold_signal: white if <90.0%; yellow if <70.0%; no red threshold in PI table
cube_guardrail: Quarterly PI is an external signal, not a substitute for local exercise packet, retest evidence, corrective-action closure, and counterevidence adjudication.
readiness_effect: Below-green EP01 or missing drill evidence blocks green emergency-preparedness claim and opens P0/P1 retest queue depending on affected protective-action function.
public_claim_effect: Must disclose EP01 color/deficiency category in public-safe terms; cannot average away with unrelated service-floor scores.

nrc_signal: EP02 Emergency Response Organization Drill Participation
public_threshold_signal: white if <80.0%; yellow if <60.0%; no red threshold in PI table
cube_guardrail: ERO participation signal must be linked to role coverage, augmentation, shift/backfill, and exercise attendance evidence before local readiness can be upgraded.
readiness_effect: Below-green EP02 or unverified ERO roster participation blocks staffing/augmentation maturity above R2/R3 until corrected and retested.
public_claim_effect: Public dashboard may report yellow/red staffing hold but must suppress sensitive names, phone trees, and security-sensitive staffing details.

nrc_signal: EP03 Alert and Notification System Reliability
public_threshold_signal: retired January 1, 2025; legacy thresholds are historical context only
cube_guardrail: Do not score current alerting readiness against EP03 as if it remained an active NRC PI; route alert proof to local alert deliverability, backup alerting, language/access proof, exercise result, and EP04/inspection signals where applicable.
readiness_effect: Any current scorecard, dashboard, or evidence packet using active_EP03 as the authoritative current signal is stale and must be reopened for source-freshness correction.
public_claim_effect: Public claim must not state that current ANS readiness passed active EP03; disclose that EP03 is retired and use current evidence/EP04-local proof instead.

nrc_signal: EP04 Emergency Response Facility and Equipment Readiness
public_threshold_signal: white if >=1 occurrence; yellow if >=3 occurrences; no red threshold in PI table
cube_guardrail: Facility/equipment unavailability or compensatory-measure failure is a mission kill switch when it impairs a risk-significant planning-standard function or response action.
readiness_effect: EP04 white/yellow or unresolved local facility/equipment counterevidence blocks green public claim and caps affected floor until compensatory measures are verified.
public_claim_effect: Public dashboard may say facility/equipment readiness hold exists, but must suppress sensitive facility layout, communication details, and security-sensitive equipment vulnerabilities.

public_threshold_signal: green expected performance; white outside expected range but objectives still met; yellow minimal safety-margin reduction; red significant safety-margin reduction
cube_guardrail: Do not collapse ROP colors into a single numeric average; greater-than-green findings must retain kill-switch/claim-gate effect until adjudicated.
readiness_effect: Any white/yellow/red external signal remains visible as counterevidence even when local fixture score average appears high.
public_claim_effect: Public claim must preserve greater-than-green signal color and cannot imply fully green site readiness from an averaged synthetic score.

cube_guardrail: Source freshness audit must check current NRC PI surfaces before carrying forward older emergency-preparedness PI names or thresholds.
readiness_effect: Stale source mapping forces source-freshness correction before readiness publication.
